{
  "dry_run": true,
  "provider": "baseten",
  "model": "meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026",
  "budget_usd": 1.0,
  "cost_usd": 0.0,
  "request": {
    "model": "meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026",
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "system",
        "content": "You extract financial claims from a social media post or article so they can be checked against SEC filings.\n\nReturn only JSON, with no prose and no code fence, in this shape:\n{\"claims\": [{\"quote\": \"...\", \"claim\": \"...\", \"ticker\": \"...\", \"kind\": \"...\"}]}\n\nRules for each item:\n- quote: an exact contiguous span of the post, copied character for character (same language, same punctuation). Include the slide/table heading through the relevant row when its date or units are needed. For speech, use the surrounding turn or period introduction when needed. Do not combine noncontiguous excerpts.\n- claim: one standalone English sentence that names the company and keeps every number, unit, period and direction word from

the quote. Convert East Asian units to standard English scale words: 億 = hundred million, so 2,451 億美元 = $245.1 billion and 623 億 = $62.3 billion; 萬 = ten thousand. Write currency as $ only when the post says US dollars (美元); otherwise keep the currency it names. Do not add a period, number or company that the post does not state. If the post says \"last quarter\" without a date, keep \"last quarter\".\n- ticker: the US stock ticker if the company is clear, otherwise null.\n- Preserve the document's stated period in every financial claim, including growth clauses. Resolve a nearby \"June quarter\" from an explicit fiscal quarter/year in the release introduction. Prefer fiscal Q3 2025 to repeating a calendar end date. Period years/quarter digits may come from nearby context, but any other added number (including the day 28 in a date) MUST occur in quote: expand the exact quote to cover that heading. Never use today's date or the latest filing to fill a missing period. Do not borrow a comparison

period or a different company's period. If context is ambiguous, leave the period unresolved.
- kind: "reported_fact" for results a company reported, including non-GAAP measures; "issuer_guidance" for a claim about the company's own stated guidance, expectations or financial targets; "forecast" for analysts' or other third parties' predictions; "opinion" for valuations, recommendations or judgments; "other" for anything else with a number (stock price moves, market share, user counts).
Include every sentence that contains a number about a company. Return {"claims": []} if there are none.

Post:
"
      },
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "Big Tech earnings thread 🧵

1/ Amazon's revenue hit $143.1 billion in calendar Q3 2023. Retail is back.

2/ NVIDIA is a different universe: fiscal 2024 revenue was $60.9 billion, more than double the year before.

3/ Meanwhile Tesla grew revenue 3% in full-year 2025. Not exactly hypergrowth.

4/ Apple pulled in $391.0 billio
